modules.name: Looper
modules.description: 8x8 looper on the NINJAM jam clock (Ninjam expander): beat-quantized capture/launch/stop, free-running clips of any whole-beat length (tempo changes never touch committed audio), scenes, follow actions, auto-advance chains, overdub; takes persist on disk and in the patch. Beta: young and complex - expect occasional bugs.

modules.name: Ninjam
modules.description: NINJAM jam client: listen to a room's public Icecast/HTTP stream, or join the protocol to decode the live multi-user mix and transmit your own audio.

modules.name: Recorder
modules.description: Ninjam companion: archives the jam to disk as raw per-player OGG intervals + index (no re-encode) and auto-exports the whole session as an Ableton Live set (Standard or Lite flavor). Beta: young and complex - expect occasional bugs.

modules.name: Radio
modules.description: Streaming internet radio source (Icecast/HTTP) feeding audio into a patch.
